description.value: Blackbird Tavern is a restaurant located in Keremeos, a small town in BC's Similkameen Valley along a popular cycling corridor between the Okanagan and the coast. As a tavern-style eatery, it likely offers a sit-down meal experience suited to cyclists passing through town. Keremeos is known as the 'Fruit Stand Capital of Canada,' making it a natural stop on longer touring routes.
